description: Validates US case-law citations (volume / reporter / page / year) against a bundled table of reporter abbreviations, flags malformed or implausible citations, and — when source text is supplied — checks quote fidelity to catch fabricated quotes. Deterministic and offline. Returns PASS/FLAG/BLOCK. Call before an agent presents a legal citation or quotation.

citation.description: A single citation string, e.g. '347 U.S. 483 (1954)'.

quote.description: Optional quote to locate within sourceText.

sourceText.description: Optional source text to check a quote against.

name: check_citation
